manifest.yaml:
schema: manifest/v1
name: Your first menu
default_lang: en
languages: [en, fr]
menus/welcome.yaml:
schema: menu/v1
id: welcome
size: 27
title:
  - kind: plain
    value:
      key: menus.welcome.title
layers:
  - id: main
    name: default
    elements:
      - id: explore
        positions: '11'
        material: COMPASS
        title: '{i18n:menus.welcome.explore}'
        lore: ['{i18n:menus.welcome.hint}']
      - id: customize
        positions: '13'
        material: DIAMOND
        title: '{i18n:menus.welcome.customize}'
        lore: ['{i18n:menus.welcome.hint}']
      - id: create
        positions: '15'
        material: BOOK
        title: '{i18n:menus.welcome.create}'
        lore: ['{i18n:menus.welcome.hint}']
lang/en.yaml:
menus:
  welcome:
    title: Your first menu
    explore: '<gold>Explore your menu'
    customize: '<aqua>Make it yours'
    create: '<green>Build something new'
    hint: Select this item to change its name or material.
lang/fr.yaml:
menus:
  welcome:
    title: Votre premier menu
    explore: '<gold>Explorez votre menu'
    customize: '<aqua>Personnalisez-le'
    create: '<green>Créez quelque chose'
    hint: Sélectionnez cet objet pour changer son nom ou son matériau.
.artisan/editor.yaml:
schema: editor-state/v1
layout:
  welcome:
    x: 0
    y: 0
